component.name: nuxeo.labs.webdavdirectedit.requestcontroller
component.documentation:
Makes the WebDAV endpoint transactional.
The webengine contribution already declares ${org.nuxeo.ecm.contextPath}/site.* as transactional, which covers this endpoint. It is restated here explicitly and more specifically so the behaviour does not depend on another bundle's pattern, since RequestControllerService denies by default when nothing matches.
synchonize is false, and spelled that way on purpose: that is the attribute name FilterConfigDescriptor declares.
@since 2025.1
